BMDT.name: Biped Data
BMDT.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbBMDT helper record, used by both ARMO and ARMA (wbRecord(ARMA, ...) includes wbBMDT at line 4004). Same layout on both: [u32 biped flags][u8 general flags][3 unused]. Verified over 520 instances in the shipped masters, all exactly 8 bytes.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas ARMA wbStruct(DATA): Value, Max Condition (itS32), Weight (f32). 131 instances all exactly 12 bytes.

DNAM.name: Data
DNAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas ARMA wbStruct(DNAM) with SetOptionalFrom(2): DR (itS16), Modulates Voice flag (itU16), DT (f32), 4 unused bytes. SetOptionalFrom(2) makes everything from index 2 optional, so a 4-byte DNAM is DR+Flags only and a 12-byte one is all four fields; 115 of 131 instances are 4 bytes, 16 are 12. DT and the trailing bytes are both optional here.

NAVI.name: Navmesh Info Map
NAVI.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVI record: NVER then repeating NVMI (Navmesh Info) and NVCI (Connection) subrecords

NVCI.name: Connection
NVCI.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVI wbRArrayS('Navmesh Connections', wbStructSK(NVCI, [0], 'Connection', [...])): NAVM FormID, then three u32-counted FormID arrays (Standard, Preferred, Door Links), each wbArrayS(..., -1). Verified against real bytes: all 4,771 NVCI subrecords in FalloutNV.esm parse exactly with zero bytes left over.

NVMI.name: Navmesh Info
NVMI.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVI wbRArrayS('Navmesh Infos', wbStructSK(NVMI, [1], 'Navmesh Info', [...])): u32 Flags, NAVM FormID, CELL/WRLD FormID Location, Grid Y/X (i16), Vec3 Approx Location, Island Data, then f32 Preferred %. The island branch is decided by wbNAVINVMIDecider reading bit 5 of Flags, which fnv.schema/1 cannot express as a value-decided union, so it is expressed here as a size-decided union instead: a plain (non-island) Navmesh Info is exactly 32 bytes, and every island one is larger. Verified against real bytes: all 4,771 NVMI subrecords in FalloutNV.esm parse exactly, 1,687 taking the island branch.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: PERK carries two meanings for DATA. xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas PERK: the record-level wbStruct(DATA, 'Data', [Trait, Min Level, Num Ranks, Playable, Hidden]).SetOptionalFrom(4) — 3 bytes normally, 4 or 5 with the trailing optional bytes; and inside wbRStructSK('Effect', ...) the union wbUnion(DATA, 'Effect Data', wbPerkDATADecider, [Quest + Stage (8 bytes: QUST FormID, u16 stage, 2 unused), Ability (SPEL FormID), Entry Point (u8 Entry Point enum, u8 Function enum, u8 Perk Condition Tab Count)]). wbPerkDATADecider reads PRKE.Type from the enclosing record and returns 0 when no PRKE precedes the DATA, so the record-level struct is the union's default. Verified across all six masters: 36x8, 72x4 (PRKE 1), 261x3 (PRKE 2), and 3/4/5-byte record-level forms; the entry point enum is left unnamed because the 74-entry table would dwarf the schema

EPFD.name: Entry Point Function Parameter Data
EPFD.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas PERK wbUnion(EPFD, 'Data', wbEPFDDecider, [wbByteArray('Unknown'), wbFloat('Float'), wbStruct('Float, Float', [..]), wbFormIDCk('Leveled Item', [LVLI]), wbEmpty('None (Script)'), wbStruct('Actor Value, Float', [Actor Value, Float])]); decider reads the sibling EPFT, and remaps 2 -> 5 when the effect's Function is 5; verified 252x4-byte (EPFT=1) and 2x4-byte (EPFT=3) across the six masters
